{{Top}}
'''Groundquakes''' were natural phenomena on rocky [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. As the planet's core spun, convection currents created rift zones, faults, and plates on the surface. When two plates slid past each other, or one under another, the immense friction caused a groundquake. Anything caught in the shock wave could be damaged or destroyed from shaking.

A groundquake's intensity was measured in standard magnitude<ref name="HoloNet News">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|regional/13314_1.html|Groundquakes Hit Berchest Cities}}</ref> or the [[Imperial quake scale]]. A groundquake rated 77.88 on the latter scale was considered fairly major.<ref name="MfMY">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>

==Natural occurrences of groundquakes==
Groundquakes were common to [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]],<ref name="HoloNet News" /> [[Shola/Legends|Shola]], [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]], [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]], and many other [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The planet Aleen was devastated by a series of groundquakes, after which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sent a relief effort.<ref name="SWE Kindalo">{{SWE|groups|kindalo|Kindalo}}</ref>

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], groundquakes occurred on the planet [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].

==Artificially created groundquakes==
When [[Bao-Dur]]'s [[Mass Shadow Generator/Legends|Mass Shadow Generator]] was activated once again on [[Malachor V]], it unleashed massive and devastating groundquakes that literally [[Battle of Malachor|tore the planet apart]].<ref name="KotORII">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

The initial shot on [[Despayre]] from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] triggered massive groundquakes and shifted entire tectonic plates.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces detonated explosives throughout the planet's caves to simulate a groundquake.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>

[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] suffered volcanic eruptions and groundquakes for the first time in two thousand years during the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
